capabilities: Open URLs in embedded webview tabs
Open an HTTP(S) URL from the clipboard
Navigate with back, forward, reload, and address bar controls
Send the current page to the default browser
extras: Desktop-only because it relies on Electron's webview element; manual installation into .obsidian/plugins is described.
problem: Obsidian opens external links in the system browser, taking you out of the app when you just want to view a page.
summary: Embedded browser that opens HTTP and HTTPS links as web pages in new Obsidian tabs.
